The speaker compares a cab driver's focus on Cisco in 2000 to the shoe shine boy in 1929, noting Cisco never reached its market cap again.
The speaker quotes David Einhorn saying Oracle, Microsoft, Apple, and Google have sedate valuations compared to tech slivers.
The speaker questions whether Netflix will still exist in 2068 due to the reconfigurations that take place in rapidly changing industries.
Tesla would not have a car equivalent to GM's Chevy Bolt until at least 2018, putting GM two years ahead despite GM's name recognition issues.
The speaker notes Micron is currently at 15 billion in market cap.
